Settings
🔮 Platform Console
⚠️ Required: Run RLS Policies in Supabase
Platform superusers need elevated DB policies to provision workspaces and manage members. Run this SQL once in Supabase → SQL Editor:
-- Step 1: Create recursion-safe helper function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_platform_superuser()
RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND platform_role = 'platform_superuser'
  );
$$;

-- Step 2: Drop existing policies (safe to re-run)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "superuser_insert_workspace" ON workspaces;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "superuser_update_workspace" ON workspaces;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "superuser_delete_workspace" ON workspaces;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "superuser_manage_members" ON workspace_members;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "superuser_update_profiles" ON profiles;

-- Step 3: Recreate using function (no recursion)
CREATE POLICY "superuser_insert_workspace"
ON workspaces FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (is_platform_superuser());

CREATE POLICY "superuser_update_workspace"
ON workspaces FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (is_platform_superuser());

CREATE POLICY "superuser_delete_workspace"
ON workspaces FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (is_platform_superuser());

CREATE POLICY "superuser_manage_members"
ON workspace_members FOR ALL TO authenticated
USING (is_platform_superuser())
WITH CHECK (is_platform_superuser());

CREATE POLICY "superuser_update_profiles"
ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (is_platform_superuser());

Audio Transcription
Groq Whisper powers voice dictation across CYPHER (chat, tasks, onboarding). The key lives server-side only — set GROQ_API_KEY as a secret on the generate-doc Edge Function in Supabase (Edge Functions → generate-doc → Secrets → Deploy). Get a key at console.groq.com/keys. It is never sent to the browser.
